title: Non-hostile animals authentic client join diagnosis
acceptance_criteria: Does an isolated real client receive the shipped catalog and send CHARACTER Ready for the same epoch/body the server commits?
Does the connection remain established during the bounded post-commit hold without catalog failure or a readiness disconnect?
Are all diagnostic-owned processes verified stopped without modifying the owner's run directory, world, profiles or configuration?

checks.rationale: Lead-owned authentic server/client join, not a synthetic Ready or startup-only smoke. Preparation and native execution have separate bounded deadlines; the wrapper verifies matching Ready/commit and owned-process cleanup before emitting its pass marker. Inspect the preserved client/server proof log; command counts do not imply gameplay or visual coverage.
